title: A Community Garden
instruction: You have one minute to prepare. This is a story about a woman who wanted to improve her neighborhood. You have two minutes to narrate the story.
firstSentence: One day, a woman was reading a notice on the community board in her apartment building.
scenes: コマ1:掲示板に「空き地を地域の菜園に?住民説明会 土曜10時」という貼り紙。女性が興味深そうに読んでいる。
コマ2:「That Saturday」。集会所で女性が住民たちの前で、菜園の計画図を見せながら話している。住民たちはうなずいている。
コマ3:「A few weeks later」。住民たちが空き地で土を耕し、苗を植えている。子どもも手伝っている。
コマ4:「A few months later」。菜園は野菜でいっぱい。しかし女性が見ると、何者かに野菜が荒らされた跡があり、困った顔をしている。
narrationSample: One day, a woman was reading a notice on the community board in her apartment building. It said that there would be a meeting about turning an empty lot into a community garden on Saturday at ten. That Saturday, the woman explained the plan to her neighbors at the community hall, showing them a drawing of the garden, and they seemed to agree with her idea. A few weeks later, the residents were working together in the empty lot, digging the soil and planting vegetables, and even some children were helping them. A few months later, the garden was full of vegetables. However, the woman was shocked to find that someone had damaged some of the plants.

questions.question: Please look at the fourth picture. If you were the woman, what would you be thinking?
questions.sampleAnswer: I'd be thinking, "It's really disappointing that someone damaged our garden after all our hard work. Maybe we should put up a fence or ask residents to take turns watching the garden."

questions.question: Do you think people today have fewer opportunities to communicate with their neighbors?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think so. Many people are busy with work and spend their free time online, so they rarely talk to the people living around them. Also, more people live in large apartment buildings where residents often don't even know each other's names.

questions.question: Should local governments spend more money on creating green spaces in cities?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think they should. Green spaces help to reduce air pollution and give people a place to relax and exercise, which is good for their physical and mental health. Although it costs money, it can reduce medical expenses in the long run.
